## POST `/api/types/coreDump/action/authenticate`

**Tier:** T1–T3 (action: read its description)  

Authenticate with service password. Service credential is needed for downloading and deleting a core dump. The authenticated status will last for 10 minutes.

_3 parameter(s) have no name in the source spec and are omitted._

**Request body** (required): `inline`

## POST `/api/types/coreDump/action/refresh`

**Tier:** T1–T3 (action: read its description)  

Refresh will update the list of available core dumps. It is called automatically for Unisphere GUI core dump screen, but must be called explicitly before a GET in order to get the current dumps via REST.

_3 parameter(s) have no name in the source spec and are omitted._

**Responses:** `204` No Content
